mapper.sql: q.id,q.title,q.source_name sourceName,q.source_seq sourceSeq,q.requirement,q.attachments,q.employee_id employeeId,q.creator_id creatorId,q.amount,q.quote_note quoteNote,q.status,q.order_id orderId,q.version,q.notice_version noticeVersion,coalesce((select r.read_version from jiedan_quote_read r where r.quote_id=q.id and r.member_id=#{memberId}),0) readVersion,coalesce((select max(m.id) from jiedan_quote_message m where m.quote_id=q.id and m.recipient_id=#{memberId} and m.read_at is null),0) replyVersion, coalesce((select max(m.id) from jiedan_quote_message m where m.quote_id=q.id and (q.creator_id=#{memberId} or (q.employee_id=#{memberId} and m.employee_id=#{memberId}))),0) conversationVersion, q.deleted,DATE_FORMAT(coalesce(q.last_sent_time,q.create_time),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') sentTime,DATE_FORMAT(q.create_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') createTime,DATE_FORMAT(q.update_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') updateTime,(select nick_name from sys_user where user_id=q.employee_id) employeeName,(select nick_name from sys_user where user_id=q.creator_id) creatorName
mapper.select: select from jiedan_quote q where q.deleted=0 and q.employee_id=#{employeeId} order by q.update_time desc,q.id desc
select from jiedan_quote q where q.id=#{id} and q.deleted=0 for update
select source_name sourceName,last_number lastValue from jiedan_quote_counter
mapper.insert: insert into jiedan_quote_counter(source_name,last_number) values(#{source},0) on duplicate key update last_number=last_number
mapper.select: select last_number from jiedan_quote_counter where source_name=#{source} for update
select exists(select 1 from jiedan_quote where source_name=#{source} and source_seq=#{number})
mapper.update: update jiedan_quote set title=#{title} where id=#{id} and title=''
update jiedan_quote set title=#{title}, version=version+1, update_time=now() where id=#{id} and deleted=0
mapper.select: select id from jiedan_quote_message where quote_id=#{quoteId} and author_id=#{authorId} and client_key=#{clientKey}
mapper.update: update jiedan_quote set update_time=now() where id=#{id}

update jiedan_quote_message m join jiedan_quote q on q.id=m.quote_id set m.read_at=now() where m.recipient_id=#{member} and m.read_at is null and q.deleted=0 and (q.creator_id=#{member} or q.employee_id=#{member}) and (m.quote_id=#{item.id} and m.id <= #{item.replyVersion})
mapper.select: select count(*) from jiedan_quote where employee_id=#{employeeId} and deleted=0 and status in ('pending','quoted')
